However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-speciﬁc architectures. Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems. claims.context: We explore a general-purpose ﬁne-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation. We introduce RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq model and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever. We compare two RAG formulations, one which conditions on the same retrieved passages across the whole generated sequence, and another which can use different passages per token. We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on

claims.quote: We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-speciﬁc retrieve-and-extract architectures.
claims.reason: 引用直接说明在三个开放域QA任务上达到最先进并优于参数化seq2seq和专用检索抽取架构。
claims.anchor: set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks
claims.context: We compare two RAG formulations, one which conditions on the same retrieved passages across the whole generated sequence, and another which can use different passages per token. We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-speciﬁc retrieve-and-extract architectures. For language generation tasks, we ﬁnd that RAG models generate more speciﬁc, diverse and factual language than a state-of-the-art parametric-only seq2seq baseline.

claims.proposal: the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claims.anchor: retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents
claims.context: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation [11], the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input. In these cases, once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART. The collapse could be due to a less-explicit requirement for factual knowledge in some tasks, or the longer target sequences, which could result in less informative gradients for the retriever.

fields.problem: 大语言模型易产生幻觉，尚不清楚其倾向生成何种内容及程度如何。
fields.method: 提出采样后过滤两阶段框架自动生成幻觉样本，并辅以人工标注ChatGPT回复中的幻觉。
fields.dataset: HaluEval含35,000条幻觉/正常样本，包括5,000条通用查询和30,000条任务特定示例。
fields.conclusion: ChatGPT约19.5%回复含幻觉，现有LLM难以识别幻觉，但外部知识或推理步骤可提供帮助。
fields.limitation: 幻觉样本质量受ChatGPT遵循复杂指令能力限制，且未探究幻觉产生的深层原因。

claims.context: To facilitate research in this direction, we present the Hallucination Evaluation benchmark for Large Language Models (HaluEval): a large collection of 35,000 hallucinated/normal samples for LLMs analysis and evaluation. HaluEval includes 5,000 general user queries with ChatGPT responses and 30,000 task-specific examples from three tasks, i.e., question answering, knowledge-grounded dialogue, and text summarization. The construction pipeline of HaluEval is depicted in Figure 1.

The empirical results suggest that ChatGPT is likely to generate hallucinated content related to specific topics by fabricating unverifiable information (i.e., about 19.5% responses). Moreover, existing LLMs face great challenges in recognizing the hallucinations in texts. However, our experiments also prove that providing external knowledge or adding reasoning steps can help LLMs recognize hallucinations.

fields.problem: 现有检索增强语言模型多为一次性检索，难以应对长文本生成中持续变化的信息需求。
fields.method: 提出FLARE，迭代用预测的下一句作为查询检索文档，低置信度时重新生成该句。
fields.dataset: 在4个长文本知识密集型生成任务/数据集上评测FLARE及基线。
fields.conclusion: FLARE在所有任务上取得优越或有竞争力的性能，验证方法有效性。
fields.reproducibility: 代码与数据集公开于 https://github.com/jzbjyb/FLARE。

claims.quote: Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input.
claims.reason: quote明确说明现有检索增强LM只做一次性检索，直接支撑claim核心内容。
claims.proposal: Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input.
claims.anchor: retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once
claims.context: Augmenting LMs by retrieving information from external knowledge resources is one promising solution. Most existing retrieval augmented LMs employ a retrieve-and-generate setup that only retrieves information once based on the input. This is limiting, however, in more general scenarios involving generation of long texts, where continually gathering information throughout generation is essential. In this work, we provide a generalized view of active retrieval augmented generation, methods that actively decide when and what to retrieve across the course of the generation.

claims.quote: We test FLARE along with baselines comprehensively over 4 long-form knowledge-intensive generation tasks/- datasets.
claims.reason: quote明确说明在4个长文本知识密集型生成任务/数据集上评测FLARE及基线。
claims.proposal: We test FLARE along with baselines comprehensively over 4 long-form knowledge-intensive generation tasks/datasets.
claims.anchor: 4 long-form knowledge-intensive generation tasks/datasets
claims.context: We propose Forward-Looking Active REtrieval augmented generation (FLARE), a generic method which iteratively uses a prediction of the upcoming sentence to anticipate future content, which is then utilized as a query to retrieve relevant documents to regenerate the sentence if it contains low-confidence tokens. We test FLARE along with baselines comprehensively over 4 long-form knowledge-intensive generation tasks/- datasets. FLARE achieves superior or competitive performance on all tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.1

claims.context: Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-3 are capable of generating highly fluent responses to a wide variety of user prompts. However, LLMs are known to hallucinate facts and make non-factual statements which can undermine trust in their output. Existing fact-checking approaches either require access to the output probability distribution (which may not be available for systems such as ChatGPT) or external databases that are interfaced via separate, often complex, modules. However, for hallucinated facts, stochastically sampled responses are likely to diverge and contradict one another. claims.context: Large language models (LLMs) inevitably exhibit hallucinations since the accuracy of generated texts cannot be secured solely by the parametric knowledge they encapsulate. Although retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a practicable complement to LLMs, it relies heavily on the relevance of retrieved documents, raising concerns about how the model behaves if retrieval goes wrong. To this end, we propose the Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG) to improve the robustness of generation. claims.context: Figure 3 demonstrated the performance change of Self-RAG and Self-CRAG on the PopQA dataset. It can be seen that the generation performance of Self-RAG and Self-CRAG dropped as the retrieval performance dropped, indicating that the generator relied heavily on the quality of the retriever. papers.quote: We introduce RAG models where the parametric memory is a pre-trained seq2seq model and the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a pre-trained neural retriever.

groups.position: 采样后过滤两阶段框架自动生成幻觉样本并辅以人工标注

papers.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 提出采样后过滤两阶段框架自动生成幻觉样本，并辅以人工标注ChatGPT回复中的幻觉。
papers.quote: To generate these samples automatically, we propose a two-stage framework, i.e., sampling-then-filtering.

groups.position: 对同一提示多次采样，比较待检句子与各采样的一致性来检测幻觉

papers.title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
papers.summary: 对同一提示多次采样，比较待检句子与各采样的一致性，用BERTScore、QA、NLI或提示打分。
papers.quote: SelfCheckGPT leverages the simple idea that if an LLM has knowledge of a given concept, sampled responses are likely to be similar and contain consistent facts.

synthesis.summary: 各论文使用不同数据集与任务：HaluEval自建基准、FLARE在4个长文本任务评测、SelfCheckGPT用WikiBio生成段落、CRAG在四个公开数据集实验，无共同数据集。

groups.position: 构建含35,000条幻觉/正常样本的HaluEval基准

papers.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.summary: HaluEval含35,000条幻觉/正常样本，包括5,000条通用查询和30,000条任务特定示例。
papers.quote: a large collection of 35,000 hallucinated/normal samples for LLMs analysis and evaluation.

groups.position: 在4个长文本知识密集型生成任务/数据集上评测

papers.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.summary: 在4个长文本知识密集型生成任务/数据集上评测FLARE及基线。
papers.quote: We test FLARE along with baselines comprehensively over 4 long-form knowledge-intensive generation tasks/- datasets.

groups.position: 用GPT-3基于WikiBio生成人物段落并人工标注事实性

papers.title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
papers.summary: 用GPT-3基于WikiBio生成人物段落，并人工标注句子事实性。
papers.quote: We investigate this approach by using GPT-3 to generate passages about individuals from the WikiBio dataset, and manually annotate the factuality of the generated passages.

groups.position: 在PopQA、Biography、PubHealth、Arc-Challenge四个数据集上实验

papers.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.summary: 在PopQA、Biography、PubHealth、Arc-Challenge四个数据集上实验，覆盖短式和长式生成任务
papers.quote: CRAG was evaluated on four datasets, which are in public domain and licensed for research purposes

synthesis.summary: 各论文均报告其方法有效（RAG达SOTA、FLARE性能优越、SelfCheckGPT可检测幻觉、CRAG显著提升RAG），但任务与评价对象不同，属各自有效而非同一结论。

groups.position: RAG在三个开放域QA任务上达最先进，优于参数化seq2seq和专用检索抽取架构

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.summary: 在三个开放域QA任务上达到最先进，优于参数化seq2seq和专用检索抽取架构，生成更具体、多样和事实性的语言。
papers.quote: We ﬁne-tune and evaluate our models on a wide range of knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks, outperforming parametric seq2seq models and task-speciﬁc retrieve-and-extract architectures.

groups.position: ChatGPT约19.5%回复含幻觉，现有LLM难以识别幻觉，外部知识或推理步骤可提供帮助

papers.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.summary: ChatGPT约19.5%回复含幻觉，现有LLM难以识别幻觉，但外部知识或推理步骤可提供帮助。
papers.quote: The empirical results suggest that ChatGPT is likely to generate hallucinated content related to specific topics by fabricating unverifiable information (i.e., about 19.5% responses).

groups.position: FLARE在所有任务上取得优越或有竞争力的性能

papers.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.summary: FLARE在所有任务上取得优越或有竞争力的性能，验证方法有效性。
papers.quote: FLARE achieves superior or competitive performance on all tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.

groups.position: SelfCheckGPT可检测非事实句并按事实性排序段落

papers.title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
papers.summary: SelfCheckGPT可检测非事实句并按事实性排序段落，AUC-PR与相关性优于灰盒基线。
papers.quote: We demonstrate that SelfCheckGPT can: i) detect non-factual and factual sentences; and ii) rank passages in terms of factuality.

groups.position: CRAG可即插即用，显著提升RAG方法性能且对检索性能下降更鲁棒

papers.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.summary: CRAG可即插即用，显著提升RAG方法性能，且对检索性能下降更鲁棒。
papers.quote: Experiments on four datasets covering short- and long-form generation tasks show that CRAG can significantly improve the performance of RAG-based approaches.

synthesis.summary: 各论文报告的局限不同：RAG存在检索组件崩溃问题、HaluEval样本质量受ChatGPT指令能力限制、CRAG生成器仍依赖检索器质量，无共同局限结论。

groups.position: 部分任务中检索组件会崩溃，无论输入都检索相同文档，生成器学会忽略文档

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.summary: 部分任务中检索组件会崩溃，无论输入都检索相同文档，生成器学会忽略文档，性能等同BART。
papers.quote: the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.

groups.position: 幻觉样本质量受ChatGPT遵循复杂指令能力限制，且未探究幻觉深层原因

papers.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 幻觉样本质量受ChatGPT遵循复杂指令能力限制，且未探究幻觉产生的深层原因。
papers.quote: the quality of our hallucinated samples is limited by the capacity of ChatGPT in following the complex instruction of hallucination sampling.

groups.position: 生成器仍依赖检索器质量，检索性能下降时生成性能也随之下降

papers.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.summary: 生成器仍依赖检索器质量，检索性能下降时Self-CRAG生成性能也随之下降。
papers.quote: the generation performance of Self-RAG and Self-CRAG dropped as the retrieval performance dropped, indicating that the generator relied heavily on the quality of the retriever.
